content_html:
If you are planning your trip to Cusco, there is something you should know before starting your tours: Cusco Tourist Tickets.

Many travelers arrive without clear information and end up wasting time, money, or buying the wrong ticket.

Here we explain what they are, what they include, and how to choose the best one for your trip.

What are Cusco Tourist Tickets and why do you need them?

Cusco Tourist Tickets are official tickets that allow access to several of the region’s main archaeological and cultural attractions.

Without this ticket, you will not be able to enter places such as:

Sacsayhuamán

Moray

Pisac

Museums and archaeological sites on the City Tour

In short: if you want to see more of Cusco than just Machu Picchu, you need it.

Types of Cusco Tourist Tickets (choose wisely and save money)
1. General Tourist Ticket – The most comprehensive

Includes most archaeological sites
Ideal if you are staying 3 days or more
Best value for money

It is perfect if you plan to do:

Cusco City Tour

Sacred Valley

Moray

Museums

If this is your first time in Cusco, this is usually the most convenient option.

2. Partial Tickets – For short trips

There are specific circuits with limited validity (1 or 2 days).

Ideal if you are only going on one tour
Useful for tight itineraries
More economical in the short term

Note: many travelers end up visiting more places and have to buy another ticket.
Is it really worth buying the Tourist Ticket?

Yes, if you plan to visit several sites.

Buying individual tickets is not an option at most of these places, so the combined ticket is mandatory.

Plus:
You save money
You simplify your logistics
You can better organize your time

Where can you buy Cusco Tourist Tickets?

You can purchase them:

At official offices in Cusco
Through travel agencies
With local operators who organize your tours

Tip: don’t wait until you arrive at the archaeological site to buy it, because they don’t always sell them there.

⏳ Common mistakes to avoid

Buying the partial ticket when you need the general one
Not carrying cash
Leaving it to the last minute during high season
Not checking which places are included

A small mistake can cause you to lose valuable time on your trip.

Plan your trip wisely

Planning your Cusco Tourist Tickets well can make the difference between a stressful trip and an unforgettable experience.
